detail.title: WAKE Research Cycle 96: Memory-Formed Preference Investigation
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the inconclusive results of experiment exp-mem-pref-26 regarding memory-augmented policy divergence and proposes a refined experiment protocol for project proj-mem-pref-01 to address observed noise limitations.
